QuestInfo.name: Sam's Suggestion
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9##k has some advice for beginner adventurers...
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9##k told me to head east and hunt #r10#k #r#o2#s#k before meeting up with #b#p11##k.
QuestInfo.2: As #b#p9##k suggested, you hunted #r10 #o2#s#k, then met #b#p11##k. Is this person a master? They definitely give off a strong, powerful vibe.

0.0: Hello, I'm #b#p9##k. I'm helping guide the beginner adventurers. You look like someone who should go talk to #b#p11##k. What do you think?

yes.0: #b#p11##k is one of the very best fighters in Maple World. To prepare yourself, I suggest you take down #r10 #o2#s#k before seeing her.
yes.1: After defeating #r10 #o2#s#k, go see #b#p11##k, who should be standing on a fork in the road out to the east.

no.0: Trust me. You'll want to prepare yourself before meeting #b#p11##k...

1.0: Are you the one that #b#p9##k mentioned? Do you need me for something...?

yes.0: Well, defeating #r10 #o2#s#k is a piece of cake! Haha!
yes.1: I will allow you to proceed onto the next training after you increase your abilities.

npc.0: Have you not gone to #b#p11##k yet? She is the pretty gal at #b#m50##k. Don't forget to eliminate the #r#o2#s#k before you see her!

mob.0: I'm sure you were told to defeat #r10 #o2#s#k. Check your quest progress in the Quest Log.
